title: Normalization
analogy: Witch Norm hates messy potion crypts. If powdered bat-wings are tossed into 3 different cauldrons and cupboards, changing the recipe means hunting down every copy. 1NF, 2NF, 3NF: She gives each cursed ingredient exactly one labeled apothecary jar.
concept: Normalization organizes tables to reduce redundancy and update anomalies. 1NF: atomic values. 2NF: no partial dependency on part of a composite key. 3NF: no non-key column depends on another non-key column. Each step stores every fact in exactly one place.

quiz.q: Which problem does normalization mainly reduce?
quiz.why: One labeled jar per bat-wing means only one place to update in the potion room.
Partial dependency: an ingredient depending on only part of a composite spell key.
